propositions: Container recreation during a landing burst interrupts in-flight code reviews before they vote, causing the LLM-Review gate to live-lock with no change receiving a vote.

The reconciler's review_and_vote path is unprotected by the existing queue.join() drain during shutdown, making it the mechanism by which recreations interrupt and then retry the same review, perpetuating the live-lock.

Deploy gaps shorter than the ~10 minute review completion time cannot allow reviews to finish when multiple commits land in quick succession, causing recreations to repeatedly kill the self-heal retry path.
The bot reports healthy by all monitoring signals (status, restarts, VOTER_ERROR) even during a live-lock, because killed reviews emit no error — the safety alarm has a blind spot.

A busy signal (in_flight field on /health) is polled by autodeploy to defer recreation when a review is in progress, bounded by DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX=1800s keyed to the deferral episode to prevent timer reset during bursts.
